sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:112

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:112:1
items.html: The third Tevuna, which is the second: Meaning, the third belongs to the upper AVI, and the second is from the discernment of YESHSUT. For at the time of birth, AVI and YESHSUT again divide into two Partzufim, and YESHSUT themselves also divide into inner and outer: the inner YESHSUT are called the first YESHSUT, and the outer YESHSUT are called the second YESHSUT. And it is found that this second Tevuna is reckoned the third Tevuna to the upper Ima. As explained in the previous parts.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:112:2
items.html: The body conducts itself after the spirituality that is within them: For the lights are the essential thing in the Partzuf, and there is no revelation in a vessel except according to the discernment of the lights within it. Therefore, since there are in these NHY no lights of Tevuna at all, except the lights of ZA alone, they too are reckoned to the discernment of ZA, just like the lights.
